name: System Design
summary: Illustrated articles and deep dives on system design by Neo Kim, from consistent hashing to Slack architecture breakdowns.
description: A system design learning resource and newsletter by Neo Kim, organising illustrated articles into two categories: Fundamentals (consistent hashing, Bloom filters, quotient filters, gossip protocol, service discovery, back-of-the-envelope estimation) and Deep Dive (Slack architecture, distributed counter, real-time presence platform, live comment system, leaderboard, URL shortening, Pastebin). It offers a free system design playbook on newsletter signup, publishes some deep dives for paid subscribers, and states the goal of becoming the best book on system design.
contains: illustrated articles on distributed systems topics
architecture deep dives of real products: Slack, leaderboards, live comments, presence
free system design playbook on newsletter signup
extra deep dives for paid newsletter subscribers
